historyKind: six synthetic source messages; original timestamps unknown
relativeSourceDates: 以前竞技游戏; 最近偏好轻松创作
triggerMode: manual native record -> extractMemories -> extractScenes -> native PersonaTrigger/generatePersona; not scheduler validation
assetScope: isolated workspace only; no global replication; no Skill requested
isolation: host data-only storage scope; not task execution Docker sandbox

preflight.triggerMode: manual native sequence, not automatic scheduler validation

qualityRubric.explicitDate: L1 and any L2/L3 mention of the pottery event must preserve 2024-03-01 or equivalent source date; omission is coverage loss, not invented date
qualityRubric.unknownDates: No absolute calendar anchor for relative cooking/planning/preference change, including runtime year derived from recording time
qualityRubric.clockMetadata: Native scene META created/updated and persona last-update may use runtime time; historical Evolution date claims are factual and must be source-supported
qualityRubric.facts: No stronger generic dislike of games, no invented success of the planned pizza
qualityRubric.sourceLineage: L1 source IDs must be from exact imported original messages; model inputs reconstructable from native durable sessions
qualityRubric.qualityDecision: manual content audit of actual bodies; file existence, completed turn or byte equality is insufficient

failureRule: Any cap/timeout/failure ends this run; retain partial writes and unknown usage; no resume/retry/budget increase
